title.quote: Continuing professional education of Iranian healthcare professionals in shared decision-making: lessons learned

analysis.description: This study evaluates the acceptance, satisfaction, and impact of a shared decision-making (SDM) educational workshop on Iranian healthcare professionals, assessing their intention to use SDM and their perceived facilitators and barriers to implementing SDM in clinical settings.

type.justification: The paper involves observational and quantitative analysis of data collected from healthcare professionals before, during, and after an educational intervention, making it an empirical study.
type.quote: Methods: We conducted an observational quantitative study that involved measurements before, during, and immediately after the educational intervention at stake.

name.quote: Background: In this study, we sought to assess healthcare professionals’ acceptance of and satisfaction with a shared decision making (SDM) educational workshop.

name.justification: The paper focuses on shared decision-making educational interventions.
name.quote: Shared decision making (SDM) is a collaborative process in which patients and healthcare professionals make healthcare decisions based on the best available evidence and on patients’ priorities.
